Don't Let Bone Loss Stop You

Dental Implants With Bone Loss

Been told you don't have enough bone? We have extensive experience in bone grafting and graft-less solutions. There are often options available.

Free 15-Min Chat1-Hour Consultation — £80Call 020 71833573

✓ Advanced Bone Grafting · ✓ All-on-4 (No Graft Needed) · ✓ Experienced in Complex Cases

A common misconception is that if you have been missing teeth for a long time, or have suffered from gum disease, you "don't have enough bone" for dental implants.

When a tooth is lost, the jawbone in that area naturally shrinks (resorbs) because it no longer receives stimulation from chewing. Over time, this loss of volume can make standard implant placement difficult and can change your facial structure, leading to a "collapsed" look.

At Dental Implants London, we have considerable experience in treating these complex cases. Whether through regenerative bone grafting techniques or intelligent graft-less solutions like All-on-4, we aim to rebuild the foundation needed for implant-supported restorations.

Rebuilding Your Foundation

We use advanced biomaterials to encourage your body to regrow lost bone, ensuring your implants have a stable, long-term home.

Bone Grafting

We place bone material (synthetic or bovine) into the area of loss. Over a period of months, the body gradually integrates this material, which may help regenerate bone in the treated area.

Sinus Lift

For upper jaw cases where the sinus cavity is too close, we gently lift the sinus membrane and add bone underneath to create space for implants.

Ridge Preservation

Performed at the time of extraction. The empty socket is filled with bone material to help minimise bone shrinkage in the area.

The "Graft-Less" Alternative

For full arch cases, the All-on-4 technique uses tilted implants to utilize available bone, often bypassing the need for grafting entirely.

Technology

Precision Planning

Guesswork is not an option when dealing with bone loss. We use state-of-the-art 3D CBCT (Cone Beam CT) scanners to visualize your jaw in three dimensions.

  • Accurately measure bone density and volume.
  • Identify the exact position of nerves and sinuses.
  • Virtually plan implant positioning before surgery for improved accuracy.

You Have Options

Even if you have been told elsewhere that you are not a candidate for implants, our advanced techniques may provide a solution.
